config.title: rtemis SuperConfig
config.description: Language-independent config for an rtemis supervised-learning run. Mirrors the `SuperConfig` object: data references, optional preprocessing / decomposition, an algorithm with hyperparameters, optional tuning and outer resampling, and execution settings. The same config drives rtemis (R), rtemis CLI/shell, and rtemislive.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URI for this config instance.

outcome.description: Name of the outcome column. Unset follows rtemis's convention, the last column.

features.description: Names of the columns to use as predictors. Unset uses every column except the outcome.

weights.description: Name of the column to use as case weights.

positive_class.description: Outcome level to treat as positive (binary classification).

preprocessor_config.description: Language-independent config for the preprocessing a supervised run can fit: the preprocessing config without the operations a fitted preprocessor cannot replay at predict time (`complete_cases`, `remove_duplicates`, `remove_cases_thres`) or would learn differently in every resample (`remove_features_thres`). Those belong to `preprocessor`, applied to a dataset before training. Preprocessing configuration for predictors and outcome.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URI for this config instance.

missingness.description: Add a boolean missingness indicator per feature with NAs.

impute_missRanger_params.description: Parameters passed to missRanger (e.g. pmm.k, maxiter, num.trees).

impute_discrete.description: Function name to impute discrete features.

impute_continuous.description: Function name to impute continuous features.

numeric_cut_n.description: Cut numeric features into this many bins (0 = off).

numeric_quant_n.description: Cut numeric features into this many quantile bins (0 = off).

unique_len2factor.description: Convert features with <= this many unique values to factors (0 = off).

factorNA2missing.description: Convert factor NAs to a 'missing' level.

factor2integer_levels.description: Per-feature factor2integer levels, keyed by feature name.
factor2integer_levels.$comment: Data-dependent: one entry per feature, keyed by feature name, so it cannot be filled in without the data.

scale_centers.description: Per-feature centering values, keyed by feature name.
scale_centers.$comment: Data-dependent: one entry per feature, keyed by feature name, so it cannot be filled in without the data.

scale_coefficients.description: Per-feature scaling values, keyed by feature name.
scale_coefficients.$comment: Data-dependent: one entry per feature, keyed by feature name, so it cannot be filled in without the data.

remove_constants_skip_missing.description: Ignore missing values when detecting constants.

one_hot_levels.description: Per-feature one-hot levels, keyed by feature name.
one_hot_levels.$comment: Data-dependent: one entry per feature, keyed by feature name, so it cannot be filled in without the data.

holidays.description: Holidays to flag, named as timeDate holiday functions.

exclude.description: Column indices to exclude from preprocessing.

decomposition_config.description: Language-independent config for an rtemis decomposition (dimensionality reduction). Mirrors the `DecompositionConfig` object: an algorithm name, its settings, and an optional feature subset. The same config drives rtemis (R), rtemis CLI/shell, and rtemislive to identical output. `algorithm` selects the variant and its settings are siblings of it, validated against the variant's own schema below. Anything not set takes rtemis's default, so an object holding only `algorithm` is that variant with every default. Decomposition applied before supervised learning. Call rtemis_describe_schema("https://schema.rtemis.org/decomposition/v1/schema.json") for its fields.

hyperparameters.description: Language-independent algorithm hyperparameters: an algorithm name and its hyperparameters, validated per-algorithm against schema.rtemis.org/hyperparameters/<algorithm>/v1. `algorithm` selects the variant and its settings are siblings of it, validated against the variant's own schema below. Anything not set takes rtemis's default, so an object holding only `algorithm` is that variant with every default. One configuration, searched as the product of its values, or a named set searched as their union. Use one configuration when its settings vary independently. Call rtemis_describe_schema("https://schema.rtemis.org/hyperparameters/v1/schema.json") for its fields.

tuner_config.description: Language-independent config for rtemis hyperparameter tuning. Mirrors the `TunerConfig` object: a tuner type and its settings. `type` selects the variant and its settings are siblings of it, validated against the variant's own schema below. Anything not set takes rtemis's default, so an object holding only `type` is that variant with every default. Hyperparameter tuning configuration. Call rtemis_describe_schema("https://schema.rtemis.org/tuner/v1/schema.json") for its fields.

outer_resampling_config.description: Language-independent config for an rtemis resampler. Mirrors the `ResamplerConfig` object: a resampler type plus its type-specific settings. The same config drives rtemis (R), rtemis CLI/shell, and rtemislive to identical resamples. `type` selects the variant and its settings are siblings of it, validated against the variant's own schema below. Anything not set takes rtemis's default, so an object holding only `type` is that variant with every default. Outer resampling configuration for estimating predictive performance. Call rtemis_describe_schema("https://schema.rtemis.org/resampler/v1/schema.json") for its fields.

execution_config.description: Language-independent config for rtemis execution: sequential, parallel, or distributed. `backend` selects the variant and its settings are siblings of it, validated against the variant's own schema below. Anything not set takes rtemis's default, so an object holding only `backend` is that variant with every default. Execution backend and parallel worker settings. Call rtemis_describe_schema("https://schema.rtemis.org/execution/v1/schema.json") for its fields.

question.description: User-provided label / question for the run.

outdir.description: Output directory for results. Unset does not write to disk.

dat_test_path.description: Path to the held-out test data.

character2factor.description: Read character columns as factors. Supervised learning needs categorical predictors as factors, and a delimited file cannot say which columns those are.
